browser-pilot do "Open the existing quotation S00021 (id 21) in Odoo Sales and confirm it by clicking the Confirm button (confirm any dialog that appears). The quotation should become a sales order. browser-pilot do "Verify two things in Odoo and report them: (1) Open the customer record 'fwod8-n1 Bench Customer' (res.partner id 44) and report the Name and City shown on the saved record.
